article_framing_rejections.headline: Big Apple Pizza in Fort Pierce transforms patio into reading room for kids

lead_independence.headline: Big Apple Pizza in Fort Pierce transforms patio into reading room for kids
lead_independence.lead: Big Apple Pizza owner Scott Van Duzer is expanding the restaurant's free book program by transforming its outdoor patio into a dedicated reading room where children can pick up a book any time they visit. For years, Van Duzer has kept shelves of free books inside the restaurant, inviting children to take one home at no cost. Van Duzer said the restaurant has simply run out of space inside, prompting the decision to turn the outdoor patio into a permanent reading room.
